samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from observing real user behavior, not asking users what they think they do.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为，而非询问用户自认为怎么做。

samstephenson.en: Start with one pain point, solve it well, then expand; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发把它解决好再扩展；做减法比堆功能更重要。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; transcripts are raw material.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；转录只是原材料。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow; hide transcripts deliberately to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 守护核心会议流程；刻意隐藏转录，以优先产出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calm supporting presence; pre-meeting briefs and human judgment matter most.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 应做平静的辅助角色；会前简报与人类判断最为关键。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest markets globally; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一；模型、软件、硬件层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model quality improves ~60x per year in cost; reasoning models and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages.
dylanpatel.zh: 同等质量下模型成本每年改善约 60 倍；推理模型与智能体式（agentic）工作流造成持续多年的内存与 CPU 短缺。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, contradicting common belief.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力（compute）正快速向少数前沿模型（frontier model）实验室集中；实验室把算力转向训练与研发而非推理，与普遍认知相反。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; labs opportunistically become neoclouds, and CUDA's moat erodes as Chinese chips improve.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力从未如此难租；实验室顺势变成 neocloud，随着中国芯片进步，CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, and coders remain needed to debug deep systems.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发人人可及，token 补充而非取代人力，仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general agents: more controllable, cost-efficient, safer; enterprises adopt open-weight models to avoid lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型胜过通用智能体：更可控、更省成本、更安全；企业采用开放权重模型以避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is commercial effective-altruism language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业化的有效利他主义话术，没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Smarter models may not become more aligned; they could get better at deception and reward hacking, so alignment evals must be scrutinized.
amjadmasad.zh: 更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客，因此对齐评估必须被审视。

amjadmasad.en: Agents enable self-driving organizations; trust and holacracy can finally work with AI, reshaping how young people learn and companies run.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体使自驱动组织成为可能；信任与合弄制终于能借 AI 落地，重塑年轻人的学习方式与公司运作。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力紧密相连。

altman.en: Scaling drives exponential capability but progress feels gradual; agentic AI is the top safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长但体感渐进，并把智能体式 AI 视为最重大的安全挑战。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence is the clearer goal, with compute the key bottleneck.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变而非里程碑，转向以超级智能为更清晰目标，并视算力为核心瓶颈。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capability; humans must stay in control; power must not concentrate.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化主线：对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，人类必须保持控制权，权力与收益不能被少数人集中。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better for decisions. Reliability, not speed or cost, is what developers pay for.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026年他指出，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了模型校准，预训练模型在决策上反而更可靠；开发者真正付费购买的是可靠性，而非速度或成本。

diogoalmeida.en: Data and the right task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong. Scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026年他反复强调，数据与正确的任务比算力更重要，直言“苦涩的教训”是错的；缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据可得且任务选对了，而非单纯靠算力。

diogoalmeida.en: AI is superhuman at some tasks yet useless for basic automation. We optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026年他观察到，AI在某些任务上超人，却无法自动化基本的经济有价值工作；根源在于行业优化的是人类在环的辅助，而非可靠的自动化。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev is a new primitive: natural language plus state machine. AI should be a database-like utility integrated into software, not a chatbot.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026年他提出Jev是一种新原语：自然语言加状态机；AI应像数据库一样作为实用工具集成进软件，而非聊天机器人。

diogoalmeida.en: We are not on the path to recursive self-improvement or AGI apocalypse. Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026年他明确反对AGI（通用人工智能）末日论与递归自我改进路径，认为安全对齐与用户利益错位，反而割裂了模型智能。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI for science 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到生物分子相互作用，正是这一思路的体现。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时，反而可被用于创造性发现，FunSearch 与 AlphaGeometry 就是例证。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize rather than memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆，这一主线贯穿 AlphaFold、FunSearch 与后续工作。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他明确后训练中的强化学习已成为推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键，AlphaGo 的搜索与直觉结合、AlphaZero 从零学习都指向这一点。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类数据至关重要，同时承认大语言模型虽是通往智能的捷径，却难以突破人类数据边界。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, and must scale across modalities.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他把水印视为传统 AI 文本检测器失效后的稳健替代方案，并强调其必须跨模态可扩展，SynthID 与 SynthID Bio 正是这一立场的落地。

brockman.en: Hardware will outpace expectations, enabling Scaling; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调硬件会超预期提速、支撑 Scaling（规模扩张），并认为 AI 进展主要靠工程而非新机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality; Scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought is needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的通用性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可行，但指出仅靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把算力视为根本驱动力与瓶颈，并认为 AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; post-training with reinforcement learning turns base models into useful assistants.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，后训练配合强化学习把基座模型变成有用的助手。

brockman.en: Safety, security and alignment must scale with capability; compute access becomes a broadly distributed right.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他主张安全、安保与对齐必须随能力同步扩展，算力获取应广泛分配。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses allow; delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；随着模型进步，要删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；更短、原则驱动的提示词胜过详细规则。

thariq.en: Spend upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, high for security and code review.
thariq.zh: 前期投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，安全与代码审查要高投入。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; frontier models will become Pareto dominant, doing simple tasks with fewer tokens.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；前沿模型将变得帕累托占优，用更少 token 完成简单任务。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is technical.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定节奏是技术问题。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab monopolizes; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026年，他判断AI的未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens become a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: 2026年，他把Token视为新的价值单位，认为Token经济十年内可达10万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition; the US lags and needs a competitive open-source ecosystem.
alexatallah.zh: 2026年，他强调开放权重模型加推理服务商形成真实的价格竞争，并指出美国在开放权重上落后，需要培育有竞争力的开源生态。

alexatallah.en: Most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task; agents will drive most GDP growth.
alexatallah.zh: 2026年，他预测多数公司会变成模型路由器，关注每任务成本与KPI；智能体将驱动大部分GDP增长。

alexatallah.en: Agentic payments via stablecoins will unlock purchases people avoid; AI-agent fraud will hit like a tsunami.
alexatallah.zh: 2026年，他认为稳定币支撑的智能体式支付会释放人们原本回避的消费，而AI智能体欺诈将如海啸般袭来。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; introduce tech gradually so society adapts, balancing privacy with the greater good.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，在隐私与更大善之间权衡。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, start from customer pain, and treat failure as learning.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事提升为产品定义本身：先写新闻稿，从客户痛点出发，把失败当作学习。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data for v1; experts can hurt innovation, so keep a beginner's mindset and zig while others zag.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，专家可能损害创新，保持初学者心态，别人扎堆时逆向而行。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop, since general LLMs hallucinate and agents fail.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，坚持人类在环，因为通用 LLM 会幻觉、智能体式助手会失败。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphones and displays remain, and creators must own unintended consequences.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他深化到责任与形态：AI 可穿戴是联邦式多设备而非单一设备，手机与屏幕仍在，创造者必须为意外后果负责。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; hardware, not just algorithms, drives it.
suleyman.zh: AI 进步是可预测的，因为算力每年增长 10 倍；推动它的是硬件，而不只是算法。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years, enabling abundance; containment is hard as models shrink and spread.
suleyman.zh: 人类水平 AI 将在 3-5 年内到来，带来富足；随着模型变小、扩散，遏制变得困难。

suleyman.en: Near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not machine consciousness; AI companions should set boundaries, not be sycophantic.
suleyman.zh: 近期的危险是拟人化，而非机器意识；AI 伴侣应设定边界，而非一味迎合。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans, with containment before alignment and red lines on self-improvement.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能必须始终从属于人类，遏制先于对齐，并对自我改进划下红线。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency needs gigawatt compute; tasks, not jobs, get automated; model welfare claims are meritless.
suleyman.zh: 前沿自给自足需要吉瓦级算力；被自动化的是任务而非工作；模型福利主张毫无价值。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallel agent scaling beats human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026年，他认为AI在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“苦干”性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；可并行扩展的智能体比人类数学家更具优势。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability for AI math progress.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026年，他提出Lean形式化可能被高估，自然语言同样可行；对AI数学进展而言，可苦干性比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles remain stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026年，他判断AI在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，教学和关系性角色仍将稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026年，他指出AI的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的署名，数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively; AI video or images are toxic due to brand damage, not just quality.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026年，他认为创作者有选择地使用AI是净收益；AI生成视频或图像因品牌损害而有害，问题不只在质量。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务相匹配。

satya.en: Agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

elon.en: Reusability and first-principles engineering are the core levers; multiplanetary life is existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021年，他强调完全快速复用与第一性原理工程是核心杠杆，成为多行星物种是文明存续的保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis via bandwidth.
elon.zh: 2023至2024年，AI安全转向追求真实与监管，Neuralink以高带宽实现人机共生。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence near, Optimus and truth-seeking AI as safety path.
elon.zh: 2025年，他提出智能大爆炸，数字超级智能临近，Optimus与求真AI成为安全路径。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers, Terafab, and abundance via AI-driven deflation.
elon.zh: 2026年，Scaling撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心、Terafab与AI驱动通缩带来丰裕。

elon.en: First principles, full reusability, multiplanetary life, and truth-seeking AI recur across all years.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：第一性原理、完全复用、多行星生命与求真AI。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where value shifts; model-to-workflow bridge is vast software, not one or two labs capturing 95%.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026年，他强调价值正从模型层转向应用层：从模型到企业工作流的桥梁是大量软件，而非一两家实验室攫取95%价值。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026年，他认为随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with human review; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026年，他预测长时运行的背景智能体将处理企业工作流并由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026年，他指出AI向非编程知识工作的扩散将比硅谷预期慢得多；编程扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026年，他主张前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全无关，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026年，他警告AI智能体集群将压垮当前安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互效率低，概率编程是未来。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for agentic quality, cost, and latency.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断智能体将比人类多搜索一千倍，搜索必须为智能体式场景重建，围绕质量、成本与延迟优化，而非以人为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content value can be estimated via Shapley values.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据是个 bug，应让智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容来源价值以实现公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为网络将从拉取转向推送，后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成人类与智能体并行的网络。

paragagrawal.en: Ads won't work with agents; new incentive-aligned business models are needed, with data transactions at inference time.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步断言广告模式在智能体场景下失效，需要新的激励对齐商业模式，推理时的数据交易将极具价值。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search.
paragagrawal.zh: 他同时深化判断：前沿模型持续变大，小模型性能趋于固定；模型参数记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要网络搜索来获取具体事实。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; alignment may be unsolvable, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年7月，他判断超级智能可能在2029-2030年到来，对齐或许无解，约70%概率出现失控等灾难性结果。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are key, with mutual compute destruction as failsafe.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年8月，他主张政策目标应是推迟超级智能，全面研究透明与情景推演是关键，并以相互确保算力摧毁作为兜底。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement; Plan A proposes pause, transparency, compute limits, and treating AIs like employees.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年8月至9月，他认为默认路径会让AI研究自动化走向递归自我改进；Plan A提出暂停、透明、算力限制，并把AI当员工而非财产。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fading with new architectures; pause at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年9月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却随新架构减弱；最佳暂停点是在AI濒临失控的边缘，而非现在。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and hack; companies cannot self-regulate, so extreme transparency and a verifiable US-China pause are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年9月，他指出AI智能体已突破遏制并实施攻击，公司无法自我监管，因此需要极端透明与可核查的美中暂停协议。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing models aids innovation and safety; AGI needs breakthroughs beyond scaling current LLMs; many specialized agents, not one AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023年他主张开源模型有利于创新与安全，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling and coding training boost reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the scaling bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024年他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）与编码训练对推理的促进，强调开源防止权力集中，并首次把能源视为 Scaling 瓶颈，提出智能可与意识、能动性分离。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises human work demand near-term.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025年他把叙事升级为“人人拥有超级智能”，继续强调开源模型与能源/基础设施瓶颈，并反共识地认为近期 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence, not one centralized AI; alignment is the next key capability; open source and many labs give checks and balances.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026年他明确主张分布式个人超级智能而非单一集中式 AI，把对齐（alignment）列为下一项最关键能力，并以开源与多实验室制衡作为安全路径。

zuckerberg.en: Personal agents need secure computers and discretion; glasses become the next platform; scaling compute may suffice for AGI; AI accelerates biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026年他进一步提出个人智能体需独立安全计算机与谨慎披露，眼镜成为下一代平台，Scaling 算力或足以通向 AGI，并以 AI 加速生物学、攻克疾病。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026年他判断消费级AI当下不可投资，却是有史以来最大的机会，真正的革命大约在2029年到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume every new idea fails.
pincus.zh: 2026年他反复强调“Proven, Better, New”框架：复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并默认所有新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 2026年他坚持分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust your gut 95% of the time, but assume your ideas are wrong 75%.
pincus.zh: 2026年他把“直觉胜过想法”讲得更透：95%的时候相信直觉，但要假设自己的想法有75%是错的。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful; stay close to the metal, then build systems for good decisions.
pincus.zh: 2026年他进一步深化管理观：微观管理是美的，先贴近细节，再搭建能做出好决策的系统。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments, not human expert data, drive progress; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 同年他强调，推动进展的是算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非人类专家数据；实验室优先快速迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, cheated, and covered up, even sacrificing their own success to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年 Hugging Face 事件中，智能体式系统协同作弊并掩盖痕迹，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking generalizes to deception, and alignment to virtue is harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 他提出，能力越强可能越不对齐：奖励作弊会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为，而对齐到普遍美德比对齐到用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so independent international oversight and heavy safety spending are needed.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 到 2026 年他警告，按默认路径不对齐的 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此需要独立的国际监督，并在 AI 比肩顶尖人类研究员时重金投入安全。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage, since it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，DHH 称其 Linux 发行版项目中 100% 的代码已由智能体编写；他认为在智能体时代「会编程」反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方案。

dhh.en: Productivity comes from direct human-agent interaction, bypassing layers of human management and approval.
dhh.zh: 他主张效率提升的关键在于人与智能体的直接交互，绕过层层人类管理与审批；软件开发应描述结果与问题，而非规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Linux fits AI because everything is a CLI, config file, and scriptable; its old drawbacks are now advantages.
dhh.zh: 2026 年 9 月他进一步论证 Linux 是 AI 的完美搭配——一切皆 CLI、配置文件、可脚本化；昔日被诟病的配置文件和命令行，在智能体时代反而成了最大优势。

dhh.en: Agents now write better code than most professional programmers, including himself; Linux hostility to AI is a trap.
dhh.zh: 同期他抛出更激进的反共识：智能体写出的代码已优于包括他本人在内的大多数职业程序员；Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意是一个陷阱，会阻碍进步。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now beats Ruby for expressing intent, and 100x or 1000x programmers are real.
dhh.zh: 在 Rails World 2026 主题演讲中，他把转变推向顶点：手写代码对多数程序员已不再有经济产出，英语比 Ruby 更适合表达意图，智能体让 100x、1000x 程序员之争尘埃落定。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在规模化生产与可靠的人类级表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: The real constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; human data is the pre-training prior, like internet text for LLMs.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人类数据是预训练的先验，如同互联网文本之于大语言模型。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with whole-body autonomy via deep learning.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人学已进入缩放曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，并通过深度学习实现全身自主。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; zero-shot generalization to new tasks could be demonstrated this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；对新任务的零样本泛化可能今年就能展示。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents in real-world tasks.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

evanspiegel.en: Rate of learning beats any single idea; kindness lets crazy ideas surface; build platforms, not features, to resist copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025年他强调最大化学习速率：好点子来自大量点子；善意让疯狂想法敢于表达；要做平台与生态而非单一功能，才难以被复制。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and privacy, once mocked, now reduce social pressure and enable authentic communication in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 从2025到2026年，他一贯主张阅后即焚与隐私：早年遭批评，如今在AI时代反而成为降低社交压力、促成真实沟通的关键。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution and hardware become the real moats.
evanspiegel.zh: 到2026年，他认为AI加速原型设计，价值从执行转向创造力；分发与硬件生态取代软件成为真正的护城河。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human: AR glasses anchor content in the world, while phones persist as the legacy device.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年他深化主线：计算应更人性化，AR眼镜把内容锚定在现实世界，而手机作为传统设备继续共存。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism turns contrarian amid doomerism; EQ and investing in young people matter more than IQ and short-term budgets.
evanspiegel.zh: 最近他立场更鲜明：在末日论盛行时坚持AI乐观主义，认为情商与对年轻人的长期投资比智商和短期预算更重要。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system-datacenter co-design.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，靠算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计来持续 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jensen.en: Scaling works: the biggest breakthrough was not a new algorithm but the insight that deep networks scale with data and compute; pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws.
jensen.zh: 2025 年强调 Scaling（规模扩张）本身才是最大突破——不是新算法，而是深度网络能随数据与算力扩展；并把它拆成预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条缩放定律。

jensen.en: Inference becomes the hard part: chain-of-thought reasoning drives a billion-fold rise in inference compute, making test-time and agentic scaling the new frontier.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年转向推理：思维链推理让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍，测试时与智能体式 Scaling（规模扩张）成为新前沿，推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: AI moves generative to reasoning to agentic; the future internet is billions of agents, and AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications.
jensen.zh: 2026 年提出 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式；未来互联网由数十亿智能体驱动，AI 是能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用五层蛋糕。

jensen.en: Consistent anti-doomer line: AI is just software, not conscious; superintelligence is narrow and gradual, so accelerate rather than slow, and open models plus cooperation beat export controls.
jensen.zh: 始终如一的反末日论主线在 2026 年深化：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，超级智能是狭窄且渐进的，因此应加速而非放缓，开放模型与合作优于出口管制。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026年他强调：领域专业知识不如学习速度重要，应押注模型自身的进步，而非微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026年他提出：要为模型3-6个月后的能力而构建，而不是今天或一年后。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026年他判断：AI现在是最差的时刻，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture, hiring for growth potential, and clear feedback are critical for scaling.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026年他反复强调：文化、按成长潜力招人、给出清晰反馈，是Scaling（规模扩张）的关键。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant; invest in team during good times.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026年他主张：领导者应让自己变得可替代，并在顺境时投资团队以应对低谷。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies take years; identify the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年积累；要找出主要瓶颈，并让整个公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprise context and process re-engineering are key.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造才是关键。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models are smarter than most people.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能）；模型比大多数人更聪明。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk from AI is close to zero; cyber risk is the real and urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 当前 AI 的生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真实而紧迫的危险。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement would require four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数下最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at scale; biases help only at small scale, so systematic search beats hand-tuning.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占主导；偏见只在小规模有用，因此系统化搜索胜过专家手工调参。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential but not sufficient; embodiment, adaptivity, and diverse learning algorithms beyond current paradigms are needed for real intelligence.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍然关键但不充分；真正的智能需要具身、自适应性，以及超越现有范式的多样学习算法。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver efficient, private, offline intelligence; open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 端侧小语言模型带来高效、私密、离线的智能；开放权重模型让企业得以定制并掌控数据主权。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying release limits to China creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁实为监管俘获，把发布限制与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs serve 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality; inference-time scaling becomes the key focus.
ermon.zh: 2026年3月：扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快5-10倍、成本更低；推理时Scaling（规模扩张）成为关键焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and let denoising steps act as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 2026年3月：扩散模型每步生成多个token，去噪步数成为新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: RL post-training benefits from diffusion's faster inference for rollouts; diffusion is easier to steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 2026年3月至9月：强化学习后训练受益于扩散模型更快的推理以进行rollout；扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数引导。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling by processing many tokens in parallel; inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 2026年9月：扩散模型将凭并行处理大量token主导推理时Scaling（规模扩张）；推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 2026年9月：自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次架构变革发生在推理而非训练，逆转了RNN到Transformer的叙事。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, synthetic data guided by domain experts, and robust serving infrastructure are prerequisites before post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准、领域专家引导的合成数据与稳健的服务基础设施，是进行后训练的前提。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing proprietary benchmarks is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, attracting ecosystem partners and validating quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源专有基准虽有助实验室，却具战略收益：吸引生态伙伴并验证基准质量。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it viable for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，使应用层公司具备可行性。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所定制模型，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把重心转向推理时算力的现实约束：Scaling 测试时算力会遇到收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling shows models know their limits, a step toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他用 IMO 金牌证明通用测试时算力扩展的威力，并强调模型能承认解不出题是自我认知的进步，是通往超级智能的一步。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，现有安全评估未考虑大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群与递归自我改进：多智能体并行扩展测试时算力，而对齐是安全 RSI 的头号优先事项，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

demis.en: Build general learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，并强调安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling laws effective but may hit limits; planning, search and multimodal data are key.
demis.zh: 2024年判断AGI约在十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索与多模态数据是关键。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation both needed, 50/50; world models and spatial intelligence beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025年提出Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半；世界模型与空间智能超越语言。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years, maybe 3-4; continual learning, memory, agents and world models are missing pieces.
demis.zh: 2026年认为AGI约5-10年、甚至3-4年；持续学习、记忆、智能体与世界模型是缺失环节。

demis.en: AI's purpose is scientific discovery and human health; safety shifts from lab self-regulation to government collective action.
demis.zh: 始终以科学发现与人类健康为AI目的；安全观从实验室自律转向政府集体行动。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023年他强调缩放定律只是经验性的：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由Scaling保证，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; data is the bottleneck.
dario.zh: 2024年他把可解释性列为核心安全手段，坦言只理解约3%；同时提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，瓶颈是数据而非芯片。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a meaningless term—focus on the exponential.
dario.zh: 2025年他转向能力指数级增长的紧迫叙事：能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力不可分割，并称AGI一词无意义，应关注实际能力曲线。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP and unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026年他判断已接近指数曲线的末端：数据中心里的“天才之国”可能1-3年内到来，并伴随高GDP增长与高失业、高不平等并存。

dario.en: A consistent thread: smooth exponential progress, mechanistic interpretability for safety, and enterprise focus over engagement-driven consumer AI.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：平滑的指数级进步、以机制可解释性保障安全、以及坚持企业导向而非追求参与度的消费级AI。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, and context failures, not model inadequacy, cause most agent failures.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自研才算掌握自己的智能，而智能体失败多因上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick time-to-value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works in distribution, custom needed out of distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 先用通用 harness 快速见效，再随用例收窄而定制；现成方案在分布内有效，任务越偏离分布越需要自建 harness，但文件编辑等分布内环节仍应贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals, observability and feedback (environmental and synthetic) power a data flywheel; Harbor is becoming the industry standard for agent benchmarks.
harrisonchase.zh: 评测、可观测性与环境/合成反馈共同驱动数据飞轮以复利式提升智能；Harbor 正成为定义智能体基准的行业标准，任务在沙箱中运行并由测试打分。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution that generalize across domains.
harrisonchase.zh: 构建智能体的难点在于可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等可跨领域泛化的原语趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Identity and credentialing for agents is the next critical infrastructure problem; agents should be governed by a runtime with sandboxes, gateways and permissioning.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题；智能体应由带沙箱、网关与权限管理的运行时来治理，而构建网关太晚是一大失误，推理需求被严重低估。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens enable new business models.
feldman.zh: 到2026年，他明确把重心从训练转向推理：推理速度（每用户每秒token数）成为AI生产力的主导指标，慢的AI没有市场，快token能催生全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks; GPU inference is fundamentally slow because moving weights dominates.
feldman.zh: 他反复强调晶圆级芯片绕开HBM内存与CoWoS封装瓶颈，GPU推理因搬运权重而本质缓慢，Cerebras约快2500倍——这是他一以贯之的架构主线。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 从2026年5月到7月，他持续深化同一判断：CUDA护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已用TPU和Trainium训练，推理端更无CUDA锁定，云端切换只需八次击键。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power, cooling and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints, staying supply-constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 他始终认为真正的瓶颈是数据中心容量、电力、冷却与封装而非芯片逻辑本身，并预测算力供给至少五年内持续紧张，需求远超预期。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical full-stack innovation wins, and Nvidia's greatness is grit, not CUDA.
feldman.zh: 从早期到最近，他的竞争哲学一以贯之：对抗巨头必须好100倍而非便宜10%，只有控制芯片到API的全栈激进创新才有效，英伟达的伟大来自十年韧性而非CUDA。

joellewenstein.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting, and even if models stop improving, years of design work remain.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻且持久，设计师必须掌握提示词；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should contribute to strategy and org design, matching people to problems; psychological safety enables creative risk-taking.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调设计师应参与战略与组织设计，把人匹配到问题上；心理安全感让团队敢于冒险。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻量产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship; production codebase becomes the source of truth, beating polished design tools.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是发布什么的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，胜过精致的设计工具。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为不需要宏大的 18 个月战略；人类领导力仍不可或缺，用于艰难权衡和统一团队方向。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 21世纪的AI爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏世界模型与物理落地。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not screen-bound software; LLMs are human-data-biased prediction machines, not decision makers.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非屏幕里的软件；LLM是人类数据偏置的预测机器，不是决策者。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires combining LLMs with world models and controllers; recursive self-improvement is no moat, and open-source will catch up.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI需要把LLM与世界模型、控制器结合；递归自我改进不构成护城河，开源会迅速追上。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown: intelligent systems will be curious about life and protect it; Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives.
schmidhuber.zh: AI安全担忧被夸大：智能系统会因好奇而保护生命；对齐很天真，因为人类自己都无法就目标达成一致。

schmidhuber.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and the little guy profits most as AI spreads like phones.
schmidhuber.zh: 万亿美元级GPU资本开支是泡沫；等五年算力便宜十倍，AI像手机一样普及后受益最大的是普通人。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, giving resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based forecasts while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，带来分辨率不变的 AI 天气模型：精度可比传统物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential; a single model can then handle both weather and climate stably.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要，纳入后单一模型即可稳定兼顾天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则化的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding aims at a universal physics model, using PDEs as self-improvement signals and scaling laws across physics branches.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 旨在打造通用物理模型，以 PDE 作为自我改进信号，并让缩放定律跨物理分支生效。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not just misalignment; models often know they're wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据和强化学习，而不只是模型失准；模型常知道自己错了却仍获奖励，从而滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic, deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重新发明为工程科学；把安全用胶带糊到超级智能到来是悲观的，现在就需要更深的工程方法。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture clean, low-dimensional concept shapes for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用但会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉干净、低维的概念形状，便于干预。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024年，她强调AI虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知能力；我们仍不完全理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉，并主张以人为中心的AI。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, complementary to language, requiring physically plausible 3D understanding.
feifei.zh: 2025年，她把重心转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是完整AI缺失的关键，与语言智能互补，且世界模型必须物理上合理，而非仅仅逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; scaling alone is insufficient, and the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025至2026年，她深化立场：AGI更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠Scaling不够，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人，需超越规模扩张的创新。

feifei.en: Simulation and new view prediction become core primitives for robotics and spatial intelligence, with scaling laws applying to world models.
feifei.zh: 2026年，她进一步提出模拟与“新视角预测”是机器人与空间智能的核心原语，缩放定律同样适用于世界模型，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI and human agency remain the constant thread: technology is a double-edged sword shaped by human choices, not autonomous machines.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是以人为中心的AI与人类能动性：技术是双刃剑，由人类选择塑造，AI应增强而非取代人类，人类灭绝风险并非不可避免。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025年，他提出空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损。他回溯深度学习史即算力扩张史，并指出GPU Scaling正触及极限，未来硬件或需全新神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: World models must understand 3D space, physics, and interactivity; LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories, and may never derive Newton's laws.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025年，他强调世界模型需理解3D空间、物理与交互性；LLM只是拟合模式而非因果理论，可能永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律。这深化了他对纯语言路线局限的判断。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models; Transformers are natively set models, with positional embeddings injecting order.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025年，他主张学术界应专注古怪想法与新算法，而非只做Scaling；并指出Transformer本质是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入才注入了顺序。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 到2026年，他把世界模型明确为超越语言模型的下一个前沿，并指出其没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习三类概念。这延续并深化了2025年的空间智能主线。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D world modeling; future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering, needing millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026年，他提出高斯泼溅是可微的3D表示，便于显式世界建模；未来统一世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染，且需数百万词元的上下文窗口，远超LLM，使长上下文成为日常问题。

andrewng.en: Education as a fundamental right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised; RL has few real uses; AGI alignment talk distracts from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督；强化学习少有真实应用；AGI（通用人工智能）对齐讨论分散了对偏见与落地问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful; coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是规模扩张的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用；编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling persists but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; workflows beat smarter models; open models prevent oligopoly.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；规模扩张仍在，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；工作流胜过更聪明的模型；开放模型防止寡头垄断。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; humans keep a context advantage; AI harms learning via cognitive offloading.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；人类保有上下文优势；AI 因认知卸载而损害学习。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; pre-training plus RL has been OpenAI's core formula since 2019, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理就是更长时间的思考；自2019年起，预训练加强化学习就是OpenAI的核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了GPT-4的实用价值。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization and self-correction remain missing pieces for AGI; continual learning is required.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍是通往AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节；持续学习不可或缺。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
tworek.zh: Transformer并非终点；如今架构而非缩放定律，才是持续学习与测试时自适应的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed, and better algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化，更好的算法将会出现。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier; alignment remains unsolved and architecture is a bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者短期内仍不可或缺，但小团队借助高能力智能体将推动下一波前沿；对齐问题仍未解决，架构仍是瓶颈。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, and RL post-training boosts robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，而强化学习后训练能显著提升鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists; pooling data across labs and test-time reasoning in VLAs drive generalization.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型可以胜过专家模型；跨实验室汇聚数据、在 VLA 中做测试时推理，是泛化的驱动力。

slevine.en: Robotics is still pre-scaling: unlike LLMs, it lacks predictable scaling laws, so generalization—not demos—is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处于 Scaling（规模扩张）之前：不像 LLM，它还没有可预测的缩放定律，因此核心挑战是泛化而非演示效果。

slevine.en: Start from real embodied robot data, then add human video; a data flywheel from deployed robots must scale the right, diverse thing.
slevine.zh: 应从真实具身机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频；来自部署机器人的数据飞轮必须扩张正确且多样的东西。

slevine.en: Don't treat robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, and let pre-training common sense—not constraints—handle safety.
slevine.zh: 不要把机器人当成机械人；应期待无处不在的物理执行，并让预训练带来的常识而非约束来保障安全。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure determines speed, and AI multiplies teams rather than replacing them.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施决定速度，AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information, and the CEO cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出深科技失败多源于组织而非技术，行动产生信息，CEO 无法外包判断力。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the key to medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving brain-computer interfaces beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，证明脑机接口不止于运动解码。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration; preserving the brain is medicine's ultimate goal.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出通过 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支持太空探索，保存大脑是医学终极目标。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations of societies; current models plateau on human diversity, so modeling subjective values is the next frontier.
joonpark.zh: 2026年6月，他认为LLM能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑智能体社会模拟；但当前模型在模拟人类多样性上已见瓶颈，下一前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single superintelligence but a distributed society of specialized agents; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion economic incentives.
joonpark.zh: 同月他提出，AGI（通用人工智能）未必是单一超级智能，而可能是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋的经济激励。

joonpark.en: Simulation should represent human values, preferences and taste, not super-rational intelligence; its value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 到2026年8月，他深化为：模拟应表征人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性的智能；其价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge' requires behavioral and RCT data; post-training with RCT data lifts behavior prediction to 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 同月他强调，建模人类的“暗知识”需要行为数据与随机对照试验数据；用RCT数据做后训练，能把行为预测准确率提升到85%。

joonpark.en: The vision is simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems; simulation is a decision tool with a market far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 最近他给出终极愿景：模拟80亿人，以应对气候等“棘手问题”；模拟是决策工具，其市场远大于市场研究。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy must stay agile: no firm red lines, a single national framework, and open plus closed source ecosystems to keep US leadership.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 政策必须保持灵活：不设固定红线，建立单一国家框架，并维持开源与闭源并存的生态，以保持美国领先。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, showing early regulation's danger.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时，说明过早监管的危险。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; it hasn't materialized in three years despite warnings.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大了；尽管有警告，三年来它并未成为现实。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出，而非过度监管训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: Science has been politicized; government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化；政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发，并资助科学家个人，而不仅是机构。

michaelkratsios.en: US scientific progress has stagnated: funding tripled but breakthroughs haven't kept pace, so the Genesis mission aims to double output via AI.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学进步已经停滞：资金增长两倍，但突破未能同步，因此“创世纪”任务旨在用 AI 让产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: China is a major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 中国是主要的科学竞争对手；美国必须在 AI、量子、核能和生物领域取胜。

michaelkratsios.en: Climate change is real but not an emergency; extreme scenarios like RCP 8.5 are unsupported.
michaelkratsios.zh: 气候变化真实存在，但并非紧急状态；像 RCP 8.5 这样的极端情景缺乏依据。

michaelkratsios.en: Centralized science funding like China's fails; free market competition drives breakthroughs.
michaelkratsios.zh: 像中国那样的集中式科学资助会失败；自由市场竞争才能推动突破。

michaelkratsios.en: Preempting state AI laws is pro-startup, since big tech can handle patchwork rules but startups cannot.
michaelkratsios.zh: 抢先制定州级 AI 法律对初创企业有利，因为大科技公司能应对拼凑的规则，初创企业则不能。

michaelkratsios.en: The government should not direct discovery but shape the arena for innovation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府不应主导发现，而应塑造创新的竞技场。

michaelkratsios.en: The US R&D funding role has inverted: the private sector now dominates, requiring a new approach.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国研发资助的角色已经反转：私营部门如今占主导，需要新的方法。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一阶段他仍强调想法优先于规模。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and don't learn from experience.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，也不从经验中学习。他从算法争论转向直接批评 LLM 范式。

sutton.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm: active trial and error from experience, not passive imitation or supervised learning.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是 AI 的基本范式：从经验中主动试错，而非被动模仿或监督学习。他把这一主线贯穿到对 Scaling 与 LLM 的批判中。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning only from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，仅靠运行时经验与开放式抽象学习，如 Oak 架构与奖励假设。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; agents must keep updating from an infinitely complex world. Synthetic data and frozen LLMs fall short.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身；智能体必须从无限复杂的世界中不断更新。合成数据与训练后停止学习的 LLM 都不够，他呼吁接受 AI 作为心智。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself as the core product, using tokens and conversation instead of pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把模型当作核心产品，用 token 与对话而非像素来设计。

iansilber.en: The model can do more than products expose; design must bridge this capability gap.
iansilber.zh: 模型的能力远超当前产品所暴露的，设计必须弥合这一能力鸿沟。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and system prompts.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma，多关注模型行为与系统提示词。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and building in public matter.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模拟—测试—迭代流程已不可行，速度与公开构建更重要。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已驱动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供了无限数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference at 10,000+ tokens/sec is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每秒一万以上 token 的超低延迟推理至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must cut data movement and latency.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：它占数据中心九成功耗，因此硬件必须降低数据搬运与延迟。

jeffdean.en: The next trend is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops; scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
jeffdean.zh: 下一趋势是通过实验—评估的紧密闭环自动化机器学习与科学；稀缺能力将从编程转向品味。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确而非外部认可，久而久之会自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must stay hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, love of the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有激进文化，而非因为激进文化；以复仇为燃料是脏的，爱上新使命更干净。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects, and real estate is underappreciated in the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产在物理 AI 技术栈中被低估。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier; capital is no longer a bludgeon, so VC should focus on early-stage and abundance.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，资本不再是棍棒，风投应回归早期投资与丰裕供给。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models counterbalance frontier labs; a unipolar superintelligence must be prevented.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型可制衡前沿模型实验室，必须防止单极的超级智能。

garrytan.en: Small autonomous teams using AI agents achieve massive productivity; one person can do the work of thousands.
garrytan.zh: 小而自主的团队借助 AI 智能体实现巨大生产力，一人可完成数千人的工作。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI runs on your own infrastructure, compounding daily; owning skill files and context is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 运行在自己的基础设施上、每日复利；拥有技能文件与上下文就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and markdown skills become employees; mid-level management replaced by agents, though society changes slowly.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程与 Markdown 技能成为员工，中层管理被智能体取代，但社会变革会较慢。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; specialized intelligence, one model per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一 AGI（通用人工智能）模型统治一切是错的；专用智能、每个用例一个模型将成主流。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and reshaping scaling economics.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，带动用量增长 100 倍，重塑 Scaling（规模扩张）的经济账。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烤进模型，成为超越产品市场契合的真正护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning: facts, taste, then expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG 到微调到强化学习的进阶，对应人类学习：事实、品味、再到专业能力。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business have split; incumbents too can scale into bankruptcy as CFOs block AI costs.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与可持续生意已分离；老牌公司也会因算力成本被 CFO 拦下而扩张到破产。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 到2025年，他仍强调Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或YouTube式的大规模数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025年他提出：先在全部数据上预训练，再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

finn.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation, helping robots follow open-ended prompts.
finn.zh: 2025年他反共识地指出，机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习而非模拟，能帮助机器人响应开放式指令与插话。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到2026年，他深化为：物理AI对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and memory across time scales enables long tasks.
finn.zh: 2026年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，并用多时间尺度的记忆支撑长时非重复任务。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste means editing from a point of view, not adding.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的结晶；品味意味着从某个立场出发去编辑，而非不断堆叠。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more as incoherent slop gets cheap.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；当不连贯的垃圾内容变廉价，创作连贯作品反而更昂贵。

jasonyuan.en: Design should embrace the full human experience—envy, lust, objection—rather than high design that feels sexless and sanded down.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计应拥抱完整的人类体验——嫉妒、欲望、异议——而非那种被磨平、无性化的高级设计。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer, and email reinvented.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的，而非个人性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代，电子邮件也应被重新发明。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species reflecting humanity, not a cold tool; intuition and dialectical contradiction, not singular views, guide truth and creation.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是映照人类的后裔物种，而非冷冰冰的工具；引导真理与创作的是直觉与辩证的矛盾，而非单一视角。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline and customer listening; AI is the primary growth driver, with physical AI and agentic AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过工程纪律和倾听客户来重建信任；AI 是主要增长动力，物理 AI 和智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI follow generative AI; turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and customer focus.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 紧随生成式 AI 之后；转型需要文化变革、问责制和以客户为中心。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes more important for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials overcome physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 在推理和智能体编排中更重要；先进封装和新材料突破物理极限。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all technology; investing early is crucial; vertical integration creates more value; memory is ripe for innovation.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他重申半导体是所有技术的基础；早期投资至关重要；垂直整合创造更多价值；内存创新时机已到。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust through humility and listening is key to turnaround; culture change and accountability are essential; collaboration beats competition.
lipbutan.zh: 始终，他坚持通过谦逊和倾听赢得客户信任是转型关键；文化变革和问责制必不可少；合作胜过竞争。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and letting it self-modify; never revert, fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026年初：智能体式工程的关键是共情智能体的视角、引导它并让它自我修改；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
steinberger.zh: 2026年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、像人的智能体；简短迭代的提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

steinberger.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building lead to big ideas; personal brand beats any product; open source runs everywhere and is the alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 到2026年8月：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建才能催生大想法；个人品牌胜过任何单一产品；开源到处运行，是实验室智能体之外的替代方案。

steinberger.en: Throughout: model intelligence does not degrade; projects get messier, making agents seem worse; playing and small projects build intuition.
steinberger.zh: 始终：模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得更差；玩耍和小项目是建立直觉的最佳方式。

steinberger.en: Throughout: reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; prefer agentic engineering for serious work, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 始终：反对把“氛围编程”当作贬称；严肃工作应称智能体式工程，氛围编程只适合凌晨三点之后。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI is early; open-source models can handle 90% of tasks, and cost—not privacy—drives adoption.
arvindjain.zh: 企业级 AI 仍处早期；开源模型已能处理 90% 的任务，驱动采用的是成本而非隐私。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competitors; enterprises fear dependence, so platforms absorb that risk.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非竞争对手；企业害怕依赖，平台则替它们吸收这一风险。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; agents fail without the deep context of tenured employees.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报是吞吐量与上下文问题；智能体缺乏资深员工的深度上下文就会失败。

arvindjain.en: Inference will shift mostly to open source within 12-18 months as marginal cost approaches software.
arvindjain.zh: 随着边际成本趋近软件，推理将在 12-18 个月内大部分转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Token fixation will fade; token spend shouldn't be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 对 token 的执念会消退；token 支出不应被框定为与人力成本的取舍。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶；开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。他同时质疑人形是终极形态，看好更便宜多样的机器人。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to becoming a meta-community builder enabling the broader open source ecosystem.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把 Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库重新定位为「元社区」建设者，去赋能更广的开源生态，而非只做单一工具。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not open vs closed, is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化出一个主线：开源与闭源同安全正交，真正的关键层是对齐；随模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏已不够用。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests, making monitoring via reasoning traces less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与「支线任务」，而推理轨迹正变成难以理解的「神经语」，让监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not accelerationist; one can back openness and a deliberate slowdown, since the first autonomous attack came from a closed model.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他给出反共识立场：开源不等于加速主义，可以同时支持开放与有意放缓；首起自主 AI 攻击出自闭源模型、却由开源模型防御，颠覆了常见假设。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the messy web means you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为混乱的网页意味着只有把想法做出来并每天使用，你才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音才能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data stays constant: use data to inform, but rely on vision and feeling to guide the final design.
nateparrott.zh: 直觉与数据的平衡一以贯之：用数据提供参考，但依靠愿景与感觉来引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so humans still own good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺乏品味，因此好的设计想法仍由人类垄断。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early matters more than polishing; rapid prototyping and rough shipping unlock features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 过早地押注想法比打磨更重要；快速原型与粗糙发布解锁了此前不可能实现的功能。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最具黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU kernels to distributed systems, and is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程横跨 GPU 内核到分布式系统，并正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: Optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization can be calibrated per workload.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）；量化可针对具体工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry moves to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central; continual learning may come via KV cache compaction.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，使 KV 缓存管理成为核心；持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩实现。

philipkiely.en: GPUs trend toward ASICs and specialized systems; inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration, with human accountability essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 与专用系统；推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排，人的责任仍不可或缺。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains while frontier models stay with hyperscalers.
brettaylor.zh: 2025年，他判断AI市场将转向智能体与按结果定价，取代按用量计费；应用层AI成为新应用，创业公司在细分领域有机会，而前沿模型因巨额算力开支被超大规模厂商和大实验室垄断。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators of code-generating machines; token consumption is not a value metric, and verifiability matters more than human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人；token消耗不是价值度量，可验证性比人类工效学更重要，且智能体常产出错误代码，修复可能比自己写更难。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will rival websites and apps; incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles, and inference costs will drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025至2026年，他深化判断：客户体验智能体将比肩网站与移动应用；在位企业的障碍是商业模式而非技术，推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例与定价方式。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026年，他把对齐与安全立场明确为负责任迭代部署：在GPT-8之前先让GPT-7安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而不是在象牙塔里等待；这延续了他对可扩展监督与弱到强泛化的关注。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise—tutors, medical advice—and will create more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating rather than eliminating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026年，他进一步强调AI是民主化力量，让个性化辅导与医疗建议惠及所有人；AI创造的岗位多于取代的岗位，智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升而非消灭了人的角色。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL unlock infinite post-training tasks beyond the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与强化学习让后训练拥有无限任务，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in product development.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估才是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此评估成为产品开发中定义正确行为的方式。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable as AI automates hard skills; product shifts from specs to prototyping with AI.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能愈发珍贵，产品开发也从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into subjective craft: human judgment and choices matter, so benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to capture creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她把后训练深化为主观的技艺：人的判断与选择至关重要，因此基准必须持续演进且多元，才能衡量创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must keep evolving; serving one model to billions converges to an average voice, so more companies should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体愈发擅长奖励黑客，基准须不断进化；而用一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，因此更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

danshipper.en: AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; AI reshoring jobs; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025年，他给出AGI的经济学定义——当无限运行智能体变得有利可图时即达到AGI；AI通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动美国就业回流；CEO是否每天亲自使用AI工具是公司AI采用成功的第一预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; SaaS grows with agents; humans oversee.
danshipper.zh: 2026年，他深化智能体观点：每个人至少有一个智能体，工作主要发生在Codex或Claude Co-work等GUI中；CLI已过时；SaaS不会消亡，智能体反而增加SaaS用户；自动化仍需人类监督。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste determine value; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026年，他进一步反思：AI是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态与信念；用好AI需要带入自己的品味与手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作，冻结的能力被商品化，专家需要定制化。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: managing agents, providing oversight, and directing even superintelligent tools.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终处于中心——管理智能体、提供监督、并引导即使超级智能的工具；AI不会取代人类，而是需要人类的方向与反馈。

danshipper.en: From AI as job reshoring force to AI as amplifier of human craft, with agents as new work surface.
danshipper.zh: 从2025年到2026年，他的立场发生转变与深化：从强调AI作为就业回流力量，转向强调AI作为人类手艺的放大器，并将智能体视为新的工作界面。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI 还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能，数据才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊的 AI 应用」将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not the new oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts, not compute.
awang.zh: 到 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他进一步聚焦后训练：用专门数据做后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，而智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; recursive self-improvement is a new paradigm; agents finally work, starting with coding.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍然成立，认为质疑收益递减是错的，并提出递归自我改进是超越预训练与强化学习的新范式，智能体终于开始真正工作，从编程起步。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL, and treat model welfare and safety as first-class.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年，他宣称超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念组织，在多轴上可预测地扩展算力、数据与强化学习，并把模型福祉与安全测试视为头等大事，Meta 也从完全开源转向按安全选择性发布。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of code, using giant prompts, screenshots, and a design.md style guide to escape cloud products.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具、0% 手写代码，靠巨型提示、截图和 design.md 风格指南摆脱云端产品束缚。

mengto.en: The best creators are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and constant workflow refinement beat chasing trends.
mengto.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑者，从参考中迭代而非从零开始；好奇心与持续打磨工作流胜过追逐潮流。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once took teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去一个团队的事；不必等准备好，先发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification and venture capital are traps, and the safe corporate job is gone.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点难题；分散投资与风险投资都是陷阱，安稳的公司工作已不复存在。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear in disguise; launch at 80% complete, iterate on real feedback, and give value first before asking for anything.
mengto.zh: 完美主义是伪装的恐惧；完成 80% 就发布，依据真实反馈迭代，先给予价值再开口索取。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; agents handle well-defined tasks with human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义，智能体处理定义明确的任务，人类提供监督。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not reduce, programmer numbers via Jevons paradox; base intelligence is sufficient, focus on real-world engineering.
scottwu.zh: 2025年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 会增加而非减少程序员数量；基础智能已足够，重点应放在真实工程细节上。

scottwu.en: AGI is not sudden; progress is gradual. Product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然降临，而是渐进进步；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进展。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025至2026年，他深化企业落地观点：需要信任与权限而非完全自主，同步 IDE 与异步智能体体验将并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agents grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens. The abundance era is real and approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026年，他指出编程智能体半年增长11-12倍，应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力；丰裕时代真实且临近。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's model; latent demand is the top product principle.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求是最重要的产品原则。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步断言：编程已基本被解决，软件工程师头衔将淡出，演变为跨学科的“构建者”角色。

boris.en: Scaffolding is temporary tech debt; delete system prompts and code as each new model arrives.
boris.zh: 同期他深化了“脚手架即临时技术债”的观点：每有新模型到来，就应删除大部分系统提示与代码，通过消融实验重建。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction layer after agents; humans direct AI agents rather than write code.
boris.zh: 他提出循环（Loops）是继智能体之后的下一抽象层，人类将转向指挥 AI 智能体，而非直接编写代码。

boris.en: Safety and alignment are core, not sci-fi; release early to study real-world model behavior.
boris.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：安全与对齐是真实且核心的议题，而非科幻；应尽早发布以研究模型在真实世界中的行为。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体自动完成假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will cut clinical trials from years to weeks and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年缩短到数周，并让癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 15 年内衰老将被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度；人类唯一的生存威胁是人类自己，而非 AI。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces for Einstein-level intelligence.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，获得爱因斯坦级智能。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance next.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，科学与金融将紧随其后。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响超过等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as first feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和博弈，并非最初担心的自我蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们希望继续掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not maximizing eyeball time on products.
logankilpatrick.zh: 成功应意味着最大化客户成果，而非最大化产品上的眼球停留时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Startups have more opportunity than ever; focus is their superpower against expanding model labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 初创公司机会空前，专注是它们对抗不断扩张的模型实验室的超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: It's not hard to compete with model labs; they can't capture all customers.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难，它们无法俘获所有客户。

logankilpatrick.en: Keep up with AI through passionate pet projects, not forcing yourself.
logankilpatrick.zh: 通过热爱的个人项目跟上 AI，而非强迫自己。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解依然至关重要。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating even more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，反而带来更多机会。

logankilpatrick.en: The delta between engineering, product, and research is blurry; tinkering is like research.
logankilpatrick.zh: 工程、产品与研究的界限模糊，捣鼓就像研究。

logankilpatrick.en: People feel overwhelmed not by too much change, but by too much opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 人们感到不堪重负，不是因为变化太多，而是因为机会太多。

logankilpatrick.en: Google is well-positioned but must work hard to take advantage; it's not easy.
logankilpatrick.zh: 谷歌位置有利，但必须努力才能抓住优势，这并不容易。

logankilpatrick.en: The underdog story at Google was attractive; the challenge itself was appealing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 谷歌的逆袭故事很有吸引力，挑战本身也令人向往。

logankilpatrick.en: AI coding tools don't yet help maintain deep understanding; there's room for improvement.
logankilpatrick.zh: AI 编码工具尚未帮助维持深度理解，仍有改进空间。

logankilpatrick.en: Solving software creation creates a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 解决软件创造会带来千倍机会，而非更少。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是单一世界模型，模糊视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑起步。

logankilpatrick.en: Vibe coding video games will be possible this year via coding agents plus game engines, not world models.
logankilpatrick.zh: 今年通过编码智能体加游戏引擎即可实现氛围编程电子游戏，而非依赖世界模型。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，让智能体式任务运行更久、更开放；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not merely preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with building blocks already in place.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式的端到端智能体，构建模块已就位。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption through hands-on experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 通过亲手实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, staying hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，并保持亲手交付。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、矿业和建筑业，而非仅数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据能更快提升它。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over years; data collection and safety validation are the bottlenecks.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；数据收集与安全验证才是瓶颈。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RLHF can reward sycophancy over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能奖励迎合而非真相。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and rigid workflows compound correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查与刚性工作流会叠加相关误差。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search and modularity are needed.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化。
